BackstoryDef.title: flesh-bound
BackstoryDef.description: Whatever [PAWN_nameDef] once was is gone. The fingerspike rewrote the body for tireless labor and left nothing of the old life behind.

BackstoryDef.title: hemoghoul
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] serves the flesh colony as a hemoghoul: a hemogel-fed body that works without rest and asks for nothing.
